Purkayastha is a highly skilled cardiothoracic and vascular surgeon with extensive expertise in heart and lung transplantation. He brings a strong clinical background with previous associations at KIMS Hospital, Hyderabad; Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital-Mumbai , Medanta - Lucknow , B M Birla -Kolkata and Narayana Hrudayalaya - where he received his initial training . He has received additional international training at the Vienna General Hospital under the Toronto–Vienna Lung Transplant Academy Program, further strengthening his expertise in advanced transplant techniques. He recieved the 2 year full term Greenlane Fellowship in Adult Cardiothoracic Surgery and Heart Lung Transplants in Auckland , NZ . Artificial Disc Replacement - Indications: Degenerative disc disease, single-level or 2 level disc damage - Benefits: Preserves motion, shorter recovery, less impact on surrounding discs 6. Foraminotomy Indications: Spinal stenosis, pinched nerves, radiculopathy Benefits: Alleviates nerve pressure, improves mobility, faster recovery 7. Kyphoplasty and Vertebroplasty - Indications: Compression fractures, osteoporosis-related fractures - Benefits: Immediate pain relief, spinal stability, short recovery period 8. Scoliosis Correction Surgery - Indications: Scoliosis, severe spinal curvature, chronic back pain - Benefits: Improved spinal alignment, reduced pain, better mobility 9. Cervical Disc Replacement - Indications: Cervical disc degeneration, neck pain, arm pain -Benefits: Maintains neck mobility, shorter recovery, fewer fusion-related complications 11. Interspinous Process Decompression (IPD) - Indications: Spinal stenosis, leg pain, limited walking ability - Benefits: Minimally invasive, preserves motion, quick recovery 12. Sacroiliac (SI) Joint Fusion - Indications: SI joint dysfunction, chronic low back pain, instability - Benefits: Alleviates SI joint pain, minimally invasive, short recovery time
